newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Geo started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Geo started as buy.

text.p: ING Barings said Tuesday it had started coverage of Mexican housing developer Corporacion Geo with a buy recommendation.
-- "Geo should see strong profitability year-end 1997 and good volume growth in Mexico and abroad," analysts Ana Maria Mendez and Hector Castillo said in a report.
-- They added the recommendation was also based on Geo's positive comparative valuation and upside price potential.

-- "Geo's strategy of exporting its technology and know-how to other Latin American markets and the United States should provide hard currency revenues and mitigate the company's exposure to potential Mexican political and economic swings," they said.
-- ING Barings said it set a Geo target price of $27.74 for June 1998.
